purpose: Executable ledger for the `route-state-core` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.

empirical_deltas.state_effect: keeps lab corridor at discriminator S3 pocket, not S4/S5
empirical_deltas.residual_cap: positive GIE-style evidence still owes target quotient, subsystem model, mediator controls, and public custody

empirical_deltas.record_delta: recent mediator-dynamics and classical/hybrid/decoherence work shows entanglement-only inference is not the whole discriminator; additional dynamics and model controls matter.
empirical_deltas.candidate_native_effect: moves lab route toward richer discriminator menus and negative controls
empirical_deltas.state_effect: field-local strengthening only; route remains bounded S3 pocket
empirical_deltas.residual_cap: does not identify full candidate ontology or settle all classical/nonclassical mediator alternatives

empirical_deltas.record_delta: subregion, edge-mode, and boundary/frame work sharpens the taxonomy of gravitational observables and the difficulty of local public witnesses.
empirical_deltas.candidate_native_effect: improves denominator classification for relational/asymptotic/edge/semi-local witnesses
empirical_deltas.state_effect: adds pressure and possible structured partial credit, but not closure
empirical_deltas.residual_cap: local witness and public bridge remain classified objects, not defaults

empirical_deltas.record_delta: GWTC-4.0 tests extend strong-field/dynamical-GR constraint records through O4a event analyses.
empirical_deltas.candidate_native_effect: raises empirical constraint pressure on candidates that predict strong-field deviations
empirical_deltas.state_effect: S2 empirical constraint corridor; no ToE identification
empirical_deltas.residual_cap: no-deviation or bounded-deviation result is a many-to-one constraint, not candidate-native identifiability

empirical_deltas.record_delta: formal equivalence, experiment-comparison loss, and quotient choice must be declared before route rows claim to distinguish candidate identity.
empirical_deltas.candidate_native_effect: creates OQ-0058 pressure: presentation-level difference is not candidate inequivalence
empirical_deltas.state_effect: blocks S4/S5 uniqueness rhetoric without quotient and residual cap
empirical_deltas.residual_cap: same public experiment can be compatible with multiple presentations or candidates

empirical_deltas.record_delta: single-graviton stimulated absorption proposals turn direct quantum-gravity interaction access from impossibility rhetoric into a concrete low-energy detector-correlation corridor
empirical_deltas.candidate_native_effect: strengthens public-record and acquisition pressure while leaving target quotient and candidate identity unresolved
empirical_deltas.state_effect: adds S2 empirical-discriminator corridor with possible S3 pocket only after realized public records and controls
empirical_deltas.residual_cap: single-graviton access is interaction-channel evidence, not full ToE identification

empirical_deltas.record_delta: graviton-counting statistics can in principle distinguish gravitational-wave state classes and support richer quantum-state characterization than a single event channel
empirical_deltas.candidate_native_effect: strengthens state-discriminator and source-model records while leaving ontology inverse and observed-sector recovery debts open
empirical_deltas.state_effect: keeps route at S2 unless public records and negative controls create a bounded S3 discriminator pocket
empirical_deltas.residual_cap: radiation-state tomography does not identify the underlying quantum-gravity candidate

empirical_deltas.record_delta: Recent GIE work widens feasible implementations and indirect-precondition tests, but also makes directness of the public record more important.
empirical_deltas.candidate_native_effect: strengthens the lab route as a decision-experiment corridor while adding an indirect-inference negative control
empirical_deltas.state_effect: keeps lab route at discriminator S3 pocket; precursor or feasibility success does not become ToE identification
empirical_deltas.residual_cap: still owes direct two-body public record, subsystem independence, mediator controls, target quotient, and candidate-native witness owner

empirical_deltas.record_delta: DESI DR2 BAO and combined cosmological constraints create a sharp late-time expansion / dark-energy public-record corridor.
empirical_deltas.candidate_native_effect: adds a cosmological-package constraint row but not a candidate-native identity row
empirical_deltas.state_effect: S2 constraint corridor because the inverse from expansion records to candidate ontology is many-to-one and parameterization-dependent
empirical_deltas.residual_cap: dynamic-dark-energy preference or tension cannot identify a ToE candidate without native derivation, systematics robustness, and quotient shrinkage

empirical_deltas.record_delta: CMB-S4-style forecasts specify decision-grade primordial-tensor sensitivity under foreground and lensing assumptions.

empirical_deltas.residual_cap: tensor detection or upper bound constrains early-universe classes but does not identify quantum-gravity ontology

empirical_deltas.record_delta: LISA mission and polarization-test forecasts define future strong-field/fundamental-physics records distinct from current catalog evidence.
empirical_deltas.candidate_native_effect: adds forecast-to-realization discipline to the gravitational-wave route and blocks forecast-public sensitivity from counting as acquired evidence
empirical_deltas.state_effect: keeps route at S2 until real public records with waveform/calibration/systematics controls exist
empirical_deltas.residual_cap: future detector reach is a decision plan, not candidate-native identifiability or observed deviation credit
